name: Trainer vs generator logprobs with batch-invariant mode on and off (same model, data, topology)

tasks.name: bi_on then bi_off, 30 on-policy GRPO steps each
commands: for R in bi_on bi_off; do mkdir -p $OUT/$R; (cd $RL_SRC && PATH=$VENV/bin:$PATH PYTHONPATH=$RL_SRC:$INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts timeout 3300 $VENV/bin/python -m torchtitan.rl.train --module bi_recipes --config $R --output-dir /local/titanrl/$R) > $OUT/$R/train.log 2>&1; echo "rc=$?" | tee $OUT/$R/rc.txt; cp -r /local/titanrl/$R/tb $OUT/$R/ 2>/dev/null || find /local/titanrl/$R -name 'events.out.tfevents*' -exec cp -t $OUT/$R/ {} + ; done
